$comment: Mechanical breaking-change registry for Programme 12. Enforced by scripts/check-breaking-changes.mjs. See 40-PROGRAMME-12-PLATFORM-CORE.md § 0 and P12-003.

policy.rule: A breaking change to a contract, a shared type, an event schema or an auth behaviour is not this programme's decision alone to make. It is versioned, deprecated with a window, and its consumers are enumerated from the dependency graph before it lands.
policy.versionRequirement: SemVer: Major bump required for BREAKING, Minor for COMPATIBLE additions, Patch for bug fixes.

classifications.description: Additive change (e.g. new optional property, new endpoint, new event type). Fully backwards-compatible.
Symbol marked deprecated with an explicit deprecation window (removalAllowedAfter). Must remain functional until date.
Removed or mutated signature/contract/auth behavior. Requires target major version, migration guide, and enumerated consumers.

entries.description: Added ResidencyViolationError and assertTenantResidency helper in Phase A26.
Added OAUTH_STATE typed token purpose for OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow.
